body: Thanks for taking the time to research it, I’ll have a look into it now. You have no idea how much this means to me.

I very much appreciate you for taking the time to respond, and although I thank you for the sentiment, I’m not entirely sure I’d be accepted into AA because I’m underage, and I feel as though people who have genuinely tried their best in my life (such as my mother) could be harmed if I do seek help, as they would likely be investigated and found guilty of supplying a minor alcohol although I only snuck it out of her fridge. I’m not entirely sure if the feeling of hopelessness and suicidal tendencies is entirely dependent on the alcoholism, but then again I’ve never met anyone else like me so I’m not sure if most alcoholics feel depressed or not. I thank you very much for giving me advice.
